question: As of 01 January 2023, who is the chairman of UPSC?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Manoj Soni**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dr. Manoj Soni** is the chairman of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) as of 01 January 2023.
 
• He assumed charge as the UPSC chairman on 5 April 2022.
